answer.driverEvidence: Both a pure getter and a mark-changing getter retain early and late findings at run7 under all three restricted-run STAR policy interpretations tested; the unchanged runtime does too.
answer.mechanism: The coarse run3 call itself creates a DEMAND helper result. Its ordinary handoff admits backward run4 helper analysis, which computes the opposite-direction NORMAL reader used at run5. The hypothesized absence of that backward reader is false in both captured fixtures.
answer.performanceCounterexample: Opposite-direction seeding plus same-direction MAY rewrites retains artificial 2^L fixed-depth width under the strict-ancestor actual-STAR restriction. This refutes a general width bound, not the correctness of the proposed policy.

policyDefinitions.native: Measured runtime behavior, using external replacement classes with the policy disabled.
policyDefinitions.actual-star: Restricted runs: remove only strict-ancestor STAR leaf contributions to same-direction satisfyingPart; allow all opposite persisted read views. Keep equal-path AT, below matching, MAY and MUST.
policyDefinitions.flow-star: As actual-star but remove only FLOW STAR actual contributions; concrete TAINT STAR remains allowed.
policyDefinitions.premise-star: As actual-star but remove a STAR actual ancestor only if the selected premise tail is STAR; EXACT-premise matching is unchanged.
policyDefinitions.importantDistinction: The incoming-STAR policy rejects a concrete STAR actual against an EXACT concrete premise; the premise-STAR policy does not. FLOW-only policy preserves all concrete STAR actual matching.
policyDefinitions.run1: Unchanged in this external experiment. Only restricted runs apply the new gate.
policyDefinitions.oppositeWrapper: The external replayPersistedSummaries replacement brackets ops.satisfying and applyRecordView for opposite producer-direction records in a scoped thread-local marker with finally restoration. Default current/same-direction matching has no marker.
policyDefinitions.wholeEngineLimitation: The complete-driver fixtures have no loop scopes, statics, ND joins or exceptional paths. Local-block reverse application is not instrumented by this external replay wrapper. This is not an implemented production policy or an exhaustive whole-engine mutant.

programs.pure: early=source(early.f.g.$/T); late=source(late.a.b.c.f.g.$/T); e=helper(early); l=wrapper(late); sinkT(e); sinkT(l); helper(p){return p.f.g;} wrapper(w){return helper(w.a.b.c);}
programs.markChanging: Same calls and sources; helper(p){tmp=p.f.g; if CM(tmp.$,T) then ret.$=U;} sinks check U. The conditional is a lowered PathEdge, not a separate method.
programs.summaryObservation: Snapshots are collected after each actual successful native run. Saved records are read before the next actual run; no records or demands were hand-inserted for either complete-driver fixture.

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

fun main() = DriverFixtures().use { f ->
    val p = f.program
    fun straight(n: Int) = List(n) { if (it + 1 < n) listOf(it + 1) else emptyList() }
    val root = p.method("main", straight(4), 3).key()
    val helper = p.method("helper", straight(3), 2).key()
    val wrapper = p.method("wrapper", straight(3), 2).key()
    val early = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
    val late = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
    val earlyResult = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(2)
    val lateResult = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(3)
    val arg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    val ret = AccessPathBase.Return
    val aa = p.field("a")
    val bb = p.field("b")
    val cc = p.field("c")
    val ff = p.field("f")
    val gg = p.field("g")
    val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
    val earlySource = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(early, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.EXACT, t).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
    val lateSource = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(late, listOf(aa, bb, cc, ff, gg), Tail.EXACT, t).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
    p.entry(root, RuleStatement(f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, earlySource, lateSource), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))
    fun call(callee: MethodKey, from: AccessPathBase, path: List<Int>, target: AccessPathBase) = CallPlan(setOf(from, target), listOf(
        CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, AFTER, PASS_OVER, f.summary(keepEdge(early), keepEdge(late), keepEdge(earlyResult))),
        CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, starEdge(from, path, arg, emptyList()))),
        CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
        CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(callee)),
        CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
        CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, starEdge(ret, emptyList(), target, emptyList())))
    ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)
    p.call(root, 1, call(helper, early, emptyList(), earlyResult))
    p.call(root, 2, call(wrapper, late, emptyList(), lateResult))
    p.call(wrapper, 1, call(helper, arg, listOf(aa, bb, cc), ret))
    p.statement(helper, 1, MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { read(ret, arg, listOf(ff, gg)) }.build())
    val earlySink = SinkRule(f.rule("early sink T"), 0, listOf(p.pattern(earlyResult, mark = t)), emptyList())
    val lateSink = SinkRule(f.rule("late sink T"), 0, listOf(p.pattern(lateResult, mark = t)), emptyList())
    p.exit(root, 3, ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY, StatementSummary.EMPTY, listOf(earlySink, lateSink)), false, emptySet()))
    fun fmt(value: Facts) = value.layer.toString() + ":" + f.ops.leaves(value).joinToString("|")
    val rootProbe = p.pattern(arg, tail = Tail.STAR)
    val result = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)), budget = 20.seconds,
        invokeRun = { config, shared, timeout ->
            println("CONFIG run=${config.index} helper-demand=" + config.demand?.explicitRows(helper) + " wrapper-demand=" + config.demand?.explicitRows(wrapper))
            for (method in listOf(helper, wrapper)) {
                val records = (f.records.byEntry(method, rootProbe) + f.records.byExit(method, rootProbe)).toList().distinct()
                for (r in records) println("SAVED run=${config.index} method=${method.method.name} direction=${r.direction} I=${r.premise.toPattern()} O=${fmt(r.conclusion)}")
            }
            f.run(config, shared, timeout)
        }, run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL).analyze(listOf(root))
    for ((index, run) in f.results.withIndex()) {
        for (a in run.analyzers.filter { it.key == helper || it.key == wrapper }) {
            println("SUMMARIES run=${index + 1} method=${a.key.method.name} " + a.summaries.all().map { (i, g) -> i.members.map { it.toPattern() }.toString() + " -> " + fmt(g) }.toList())
        }
        for (method in listOf(helper, wrapper)) for (link in f.links(index + 1, method)) println("LINK run=${index + 1} method=${method.method.name} $link")
    }
    for (row in f.processed) println("PROCESSED run=${row.run} method=${row.method.method.name} I=${row.delta.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} F=${fmt(row.delta.facts)}")
    println("RESULT latest=run-${result.end.run} status=${result.end.status} findings=" + result.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId })
}

        CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),

    ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)

    p.call(root, 2, call(wrapper, late, emptyList(), lateResult))

    p.exit(root, 3, ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY, StatementSummary.EMPTY, listOf(earlySink, lateSink)), false, emptySet()))
    fun fmt(value: Facts) = value.layer.toString() + ":" + f.ops.leaves(value).joinToString("|")
    val rootProbe = p.pattern(arg, tail = Tail.STAR)
    val result = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)), budget = 20.seconds,
        invokeRun = { config, shared, timeout ->
            println("CONFIG run=${config.index} helper-demand=" + config.demand?.explicitRows(helper) + " wrapper-demand=" + config.demand?.explicitRows(wrapper))
            for (method in listOf(helper, wrapper)) {
                val records = (f.records.byEntry(method, rootProbe) + f.records.byExit(method, rootProbe)).toList().distinct()
                for (r in records) println("SAVED run=${config.index} method=${method.method.name} direction=${r.direction} I=${r.premise.toPattern()} O=${fmt(r.conclusion)}")
            }
            f.run(config, shared, timeout)
        }, run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL).analyze(listOf(root))
    for ((index, run) in f.results.withIndex()) {

            println("SUMMARIES run=${index + 1} method=${a.key.method.name} " + a.summaries.all().map { (i, g) -> i.members.map { it.toPattern() }.toString() + " -> " + fmt(g) }.toList())
        }
        for (method in listOf(helper, wrapper)) for (link in f.links(index + 1, method)) println("LINK run=${index + 1} method=${method.method.name} $link")

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.Record

/** Read the previous-run store on every original offer, without live input history. */
internal fun replayPersistedSummaries(
    config: RunConfig,
    ops: ApOps,
    part: Subscription,
    applier: SummaryApplier,
    statistics: N2Statistics? = null,
) {
    check(config.restricted && !part.zeroOnly)
    val records = config.records
    val direction = config.direction
    val mode = config.mode
    val cancellation = ops.manager.cancellation
    statistics?.persistedReplayStarted()
    val seen = HashSet<Record>()
    val seenViews = HashMap<RecordLeafView, Boolean>()
    for (leaf in ops.leaves(part.added)) {
        cancellation.checkpoint()
        for (record in records.byEntry(part.callee, leaf)) {
            cancellation.checkpoint()
            statistics?.persistedReplayCandidate()
            if (record.direction != direction || !seen.add(record)) continue
            val added = ops.satisfying(part.added, record.premise, mode, record = true) ?: continue
            statistics?.persistedReplayMatched()
            applier.applyRecord(part.copy(added = added), record)
        }
        for (record in records.byExit(part.callee, leaf)) {
            cancellation.checkpoint()
            statistics?.persistedReplayCandidate()
            if (record.direction == direction) continue
            record.forEachReversedAt(leaf) { view, nonSubsumable ->
                cancellation.checkpoint()
                val previous = seenViews[view]
                if (previous == true || previous == false && !nonSubsumable) return@forEachReversedAt
                seenViews[view] = previous == true || nonSubsumable
                SameDirectionStarPolicy.opposite {
                    val added = ops.satisfying(part.added, view.premise, mode, record = true)
                        ?: return@opposite
                    statistics?.persistedReplayMatched()
                    applier.applyRecordView(part.copy(added = added), view, nonSubsumable)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.StoreFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*

private fun quote(s: String): String = "\"" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""
private fun json(x: Any?): String = when (x) {
    null -> "null"
    is String -> quote(x)
    is Boolean, is Number -> x.toString()
    is Map<*, *> -> x.entries.joinToString(",", "{", "}") { quote(it.key.toString()) + ":" + json(it.value) }
    is Iterable<*> -> x.joinToString(",", "[", "]") { json(it) }
    else -> error("JSON")
}
private class Captured : LocalRelationOut {
    val facts = ArrayList<Facts>()
    val targets = ArrayList<String>()
    val requests = ArrayList<Int>()
    override fun data(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) { facts += value }
    override fun target(original: PremiseKey, target: Target) { targets += target.toString() }
    override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) { requests += mark.id }
}
fun main() {
    val f = StoreFixtures()
    val ap = f.manager
    val ops = f.ops
    val p = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    val q = AccessPathBase.Return
    val ff = f.field("f")
    val gg = f.field("g")
    val hh = f.field("h")
    val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(f.mark("T"))
    val u = MarkSlot.Concrete(f.mark("U"))
    val mode = ApMode(false, Direction.FORWARD, 8)
    val application = LocalRelationApplication(ops, mode)
    val deep = ap.initial(f.pattern(p, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR))
    val direct = Record(f.method, Direction.FORWARD, deep, f.fact(q, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = MarkSlot.STAR))
    val point = Record(f.method, Direction.FORWARD,
        ap.initial(f.pattern(p, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.EXACT, t)), f.fact(q, mark = u))
    val reversed = Record(f.method, Direction.BACKWARD,
        ap.initial(f.pattern(q, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = MarkSlot.STAR)), f.fact(p, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR))
    fun desc(value: Facts): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("layer" to value.layer.name,
        "rows" to ops.leaves(value).map { pat -> linkedMapOf("base" to pat.fact.base.toString(),
            "path" to pat.fact.path, "tail" to pat.fact.tail.name, "E" to pat.exclusion.toString(),
            "mark" to pat.fact.mark.toString()) }.toList(),
        "protection" to (value as? TaintTree)?.nonSubsumable?.toString())
    val cases = listOf(
        Triple("same-direction FLOW STAR strict ancestor", direct, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = MarkSlot.STAR)),
        Triple("same-direction FLOW STAR same path", direct, f.fact(p, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR)),
        Triple("same-direction FLOW STAR below", direct, f.fact(p, listOf(ff, gg, hh), Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR)),
        Triple("same-direction FLOW MAY strict ancestor", direct, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.ANY, mark = MarkSlot.STAR, layer = Layer.DEMAND)),
        Triple("same-direction FLOW MUST strict ancestor", direct, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark = MarkSlot.STAR)),
        Triple("same-direction concrete STAR strict ancestor through FLOW", direct, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = t)),
        Triple("same-direction concrete STAR strict ancestor through EXACT", point, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = t)),
        Triple("opposite-direction FLOW STAR strict ancestor", reversed, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = MarkSlot.STAR)),
        Triple("opposite-direction concrete STAR strict ancestor", reversed, f.fact(p, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = t))
    )
    val policy = System.getProperty("probe.policy", "native")
    val results = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    for ((name, record, actual) in cases) {
        val output = Captured()
        val original = ap.initial(ops.leaves(actual).single())
        if (record.direction == mode.direction) application.applyRecord(actual, original, record, output)
        else SameDirectionStarPolicy.opposite {
            for (leaf in ops.leaves(actual)) record.forEachReversedAt(leaf) { view, protected ->
                application.applyRecordView(actual, original, view, protected, output)
            }
        }
        check(output.requests.isEmpty() && output.targets.isEmpty())
        val blocked = name == "same-direction FLOW STAR strict ancestor" && policy != "native" ||
            name == "same-direction concrete STAR strict ancestor through FLOW" && policy in listOf("actual-star", "premise-star") ||
            name == "same-direction concrete STAR strict ancestor through EXACT" && policy == "actual-star"
        check(output.facts.isEmpty() == blocked) { "$policy / $name / ${output.facts.map(::desc)}" }
        results += linkedMapOf("case" to name, "producerDirection" to record.direction.name,
            "readerDirection" to mode.direction.name, "premise" to record.premise.toString(),
            "conclusion" to desc(record.conclusion), "actual" to desc(actual), "outputs" to output.facts.map(::desc),
            "requests" to output.requests, "targets" to output.targets)
    }
    println(json(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS", "policy" to policy, "controls" to results)))
}

}
private class Output : LocalRelationOut {
    val data = ArrayList<Facts>()
    val requests = ArrayList<Int>()
    val targets = ArrayList<String>()
    override fun data(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) { data += value }
    override fun target(original: PremiseKey, target: Target) { targets += target.toString() }
    override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) { requests += mark.id }
}
fun main() {
    val f = StoreFixtures()
    val ap = f.manager
    val ops = f.ops
    val p = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(23)
    val q = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(18)
    val a = f.field("f")
    val b = f.field("g")
    val c = f.field("h")
    val d = f.field("k")
    val t = f.mark("T")
    val u = f.mark("U")
    val mx = MarkExclusions.of(ap.marks, listOf(t, u))
    val mode = ApMode(false, Direction.BACKWARD, 8)
    val application = LocalRelationApplication(ops, mode)
    val paths = listOf(listOf(a), listOf(a,b), listOf(a,b,c), listOf(d))
    fun desc(value: Facts): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("layer" to value.layer.name,
        "rows" to ops.leaves(value).map { pattern -> linkedMapOf("base" to pattern.fact.base.toString(),
            "path" to pattern.fact.path, "tail" to pattern.fact.tail.name,
            "E" to (pattern.exclusion as? ExclusionSet.Concrete)?.ids?.toList().orEmpty(),
            "mark" to when (val mark = pattern.fact.mark) {
                is MarkSlot.Star -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "FLOW", "mx" to mark.excluded.ids.toList())
                is MarkSlot.Concrete -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "CONCRETE", "id" to mark.mark.id)
            }) }.toList())
    val controls = emptyList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    // AP-level fixed-point mechanism only: existing NORMAL rows, not an analyzer run.
    val zero = f.field("bit0")
    val one = f.field("bit1")
    val closureCases = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    for (length in 1..8) {
        val loopMode = ApMode(false,Direction.FORWARD,length+2)
        val loopApp = LocalRelationApplication(ops,loopMode)
        val restriction = LoopOutputRestriction(ops)
        val base = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val original = ap.initial(f.pattern(base,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR))
        val firstScope = BlockScope(BlockId(2),PortId(20))
        val repeatScope = BlockScope(BlockId(2),PortId(80))
        fun row(input: List<Int>,output: List<Int>,scope: BlockScope) = Record(f.method,Direction.FORWARD,
            ap.initial(f.pattern(base,input,Tail.STAR,MarkSlot.STAR)),f.fact(base,output,Tail.STAR,MarkSlot.STAR),scope,PortId(80))
        val seedPath = List(length) { zero }
        val seed = Record(f.method, Direction.BACKWARD,
            ap.initial(f.pattern(base, seedPath, Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR)),
            f.fact(base, seedPath, Tail.STAR, MarkSlot.STAR),
            BlockScope(BlockId(2), PortId(80)), PortId(20))
        check(seed.scopeIn(Direction.FORWARD) == firstScope)
        check(seed.exitIn(Direction.FORWARD) == PortId(80))
        val repeatRows = (0 until length).map { k -> row(List(k) { one } + zero,List(k) { zero } + one,repeatScope) }
        val actual = f.fact(base,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR)
        val queue = ArrayDeque<Facts>()
        val store = FlowGroup(ap,ap.newInterners().flow)
        var observations = 0
        var attempts = 0
        var successfulApplications = 0
        fun apply(record: Record,input: Facts) {
            attempts++
            val out = Output()
            val matched = if (record.direction == Direction.FORWARD) loopApp.applyRecord(input, original, record, out)
            else SameDirectionStarPolicy.opposite {
                var hit = false
                for (leaf in ops.leaves(input)) record.forEachReversedAt(leaf) { view, protected ->
                    hit = loopApp.applyRecordView(input, original, view, protected, out) || hit
                }
                hit
            }
            if (matched) successfulApplications++
            check(out.targets.isEmpty() && out.requests.isEmpty())
            val geometry = ops.leaves(record.conclusion).single()
            check(!loopSummaryGrows(record.premise,geometry))
            for (value in out.data) ops.limit(value,loopMode.fieldLimit,object:ApOut {
                override fun result(fact: Facts) {
                    for (kept in restriction.restrict(false,record.premise,geometry,fact) {
                        observations++
                        LoopObservation<Unit>(emptySet(),emptySet(),emptySet())
                    }) {
                        check(kept.layer == Layer.DEMAND)
                        store.add(kept as FlowTree)?.let(queue::addLast)
                    }
                }
                override fun markRequest(mark:TaintMark) = error("No limit request")
            })
        }
        apply(seed,actual)
        var processed = 0
        while (queue.isNotEmpty()) {
            val input = queue.removeFirst()
            processed++
            for (record in repeatRows) apply(record,input)
            check(processed <= (1 shl length))
        }
        val finalPaths = store.all().flatMap { ops.leaves(it) }.map { it.fact.path }.toSet()
        check(finalPaths.size == 1 shl length)
        check(finalPaths.all { it.size == length })
        check(observations == 0)
        closureCases += linkedMapOf("storedMaxDepth" to length,"currentFieldLimit" to loopMode.fieldLimit,
            "normalRows" to length+1,"firstEntryScope" to firstScope.toString(),"repeatScope" to repeatScope.toString(),
            "initialActual" to desc(actual),"seedRecordPremisePath" to seedPath, "seedProducerDirection" to seed.direction.name, "repeatProducerDirection" to "FORWARD", "policy" to System.getProperty("probe.policy"),
            "repeatRule" to "1^k 0 -> 0^k 1, k=0..L-1; equal stored prefix lengths; known suffix retained",
            "nativeAttempts" to attempts,"nativeSuccessfulApplications" to successfulApplications,
            "freshCompletionPackets" to processed,"finalDistinctDepthLPaths" to finalPaths.size,
            "loopConsumerObservations" to observations,"allStoredRowsNonGrowing" to true)
    }
    println(json(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS","runtimeRevision" to "52f32dd437d438aec4a700a02c18d94c31d58093",
        "groupingControls" to controls,"widthMechanismControls" to closureCases,
        "limits" to listOf("Native AP and loop restriction controls only; no analyzer or code-under-analysis run",
            "The width construction uses distinct genuine first-entry/repeat record scopes; it does not claim actual Stirling/Conductor implements a binary counter",
            "The seed increases known actual prefix from0 to stored depthL via ancestor STAR inside despite equal stored geometry",
            "A single equal-length row is insufficient for exponential depth; this construction has O(L) rows and2^L fixed-depth paths",
            "Grouping proof preserves outside-cell at/below applications; actual replay must retain both growth strata"))))
}
